notes.title: DEMO PATCH NOTES V0.1
notes.content:
Demo Build V0.1 Patch Notes

Bug Fixes
	-Socials now appear on main screen

Stage changes
	-BackStreet Brawl NPCs given lighter outline colour

Character Changes
	UNIVERSAL

	ALAN
		SPECIAL 1 [SONIC WAVE]
			All levels are now Air OK
		SPECIAL 2 [TORNADO KICK]
			Fixed bug where it couldnt be used after airdashing
	HALEY

	VANESSA
		SPECIAL 2 [THROW-YO]
			All levels are now Air OK
	MAGNUS

	CAT
		SPECIAL 1 [PURRINTER]
			All levels are now air OK
		SPECIAL 2 [CLAW ENFORCEMENT]
			Fixed bug where it couldnt be used after airdashing	


I will slowly be adding in more air specials over time, enjoy these for now!
